title: Make flashlight toggle polling usable
objective: Fix examples/flashlight/run.py so Xbox controller button presses are not missed during flashlight toggle polling.
instructions: Edit examples/flashlight/run.py only; this file is explicitly authorized for this task.
Xbox mapping note: Unreal Gamepad_FaceButton_Right is Xbox B; keep this default unless changing it is necessary.
Try to add a helper around player_controller.IsInputKeyDown(Key=key) and use previous/current state edge detection for --toggle-key.
If IsInputKeyDown cannot be confidently used from this Python/Unreal bridge, reduce --idle-period-seconds default from 0.5 to a responsive value such as 0.02 and explain that fix.
Keep Enter pose capture intact. If using key-down edge detection, apply it to controller capture too; otherwise leave capture logic unchanged except for faster polling.
expected_outputs: Explain final Xbox button mapping and why previous version could fail.
definition_of_done: A normal Xbox B button press should be detected without an unusually long hold.
